entries.note: Neither proximity to the forefront nor an effectively vanished competitive advantage has a shared test across this combined claim.
'Bad news' expresses an assessment without specifying a business outcome.

entries.test: Public technical and cost records showing whether competitive models could be built without the claimed spending, grid strain and emissions-goal breaches would test the asserted necessity.
entries.note: The proposition captures his rejection of the necessity premise.

entries.test: Public financing terms, compute agreements and documented efficiency investments would test whether access to capital and hyperscaler incentives removed meaningful pressure to improve efficiency.
entries.note: He offers a causal hypothesis about business incentives; that can be evaluated through public business records.
The combined claim includes the explicitly hedged counterfactual 'likely would've been allowed'.
The preceding 'potentially, nobody was trying' supplies the hedge retained in the proposition.
'Public companies wearing startup suits' is a metaphor, not an assertion of public listing status. The passage primarily delivers a disparaging characterization.
'Aren't building shit' is dismissive exaggeration in a passage that acknowledges their products elsewhere.
The central predicted outcome is every investor privately thinking twice. Funding totals cannot establish that universal mental response.
The competitive outcome is qualified by 'almost certainly', and the benefit assessment by 'hard to see how'.
The question contains an endorsed judgment about the models' worth and whether valuations are justified.
The relevant assertion is Zitron's commentary, not Altman's quoted promise. 'Even come close' to AGI lacks a shared threshold here.
'Some form of existential wound' is an unspecified metaphor, not a firm prediction that OpenAI will fail.

entries.test: DeepSeek's public releases, licenses and technical papers, together with independent performance and deployment evidence, would establish whether competitive LLMs became broadly reproducible and available.
entries.note: The surrounding text gives commoditization a concrete reading: others can deploy or build on competitive models.
The central assertion assigns a private motive for avoiding efficient open models.

entries.test: Public industry revenue data showing a commercial generative-AI market reaching multiple trillions of dollars annually would refute the claimed market ceiling.
entries.note: The passage asserts a firm commercial ceiling without a deadline.

entries.test: OpenAI's publicly reported revenue breakdown at publication would establish the model-access share and the stated model-access and ChatGPT subscription amounts.
entries.note: These are specific financial assertions, regardless of whether the cited figures are accurate.
'The real danger' specifies neither the threatened outcome nor a measure for comparing V3 with R1.

entries.test: Public compute holdings, model-development capabilities and Microsoft–OpenAI licensing terms would establish whether material technical or contractual barriers prevented hyperscalers from replacing GPT and Claude.
entries.note: The metaphor is supported by concrete assertions about resources, rights and barriers.

entries.test: Publicly documented companies whose deployments were blocked by contemporary LLM pricing, and market evidence of cost-blocked use cases, would test his assertion.
entries.note: 'I do not believe' introduces his asserted assessment rather than an explicit chance estimate. A documented company blocked by pricing could refute its universal first part.
'I could absolutely see' expresses a possibility, not a commitment that Meta will release such models.
The claim does not specify to whom ChatGPT is essential or what treatment as essential entails.

entries.test: Public deployment studies and customer evidence comparing the effects of inference prices with capability and reliability limitations would test his explanation for constrained adoption and success.
entries.note: The concrete causal assertion about costs versus capabilities is testable despite the smartphone analogy.
'Nothing left' is sweeping rhetorical dismissal, with no specified business or technical outcome.

entries.test: Public demonstrations and independently verified deployments of AI systems reliably carrying out delegated multistep tasks would refute the prediction that agents are not coming.
entries.note: This is a firm, undated negative forecast. The surrounding discussion of Operator supplies a practical meaning for agents.
